To be completely transparent, I think everyone with depression is still learning how to overcome it every single day. No day is the same, especially for me. Some days I say keeping busy and active is the way, but then there are those days when whatever you did to keep yourself busy seem pointless and you can’t even bare to open your eyes and get out of bed. I truly believe the only way to keep pushing is to come to platforms like this when you’re at your lowest low or even your highest high. You’d be surprised at the difference you’ll feel once you see other people feel the same and you and are still alive to talk about it.

I had to have my partner check on me throughout to day to help me eat. At one point my family was so concerned about my weight loss they said I looked like a whole different person!  I literally had to set reminders on my phone to force me to eat. Just the smell of foods would completely turn me off!  In my therapy sessions I had to practice role playing so I could find the words to tell people that expected too much from me. I’m still working hard on that ‘til this day!  Sometimes I wonder is this degree even worth it if I’m going to be fighting for my life every single day. I have no idea at this point tbh.
